main_text.l: Si Magistratus jure divino potestatem habet
è verbo Dei ista potestas. In Vet. Testamento
ministros cultus divini, sed ipse Deus sibi selegit
tribum Levi, Aaronemque, & ejus posteros, ipse
constituit in sacerdotes. In Novo Test. Ipse
listas, Pastores & Doctores: quæ deinceps, per
instituerunt. Ubi ergo jus illud divinum?
Aliud est pastorem nen præfici Ecclesiæ, ubi illa in
Pastor ille in publico loqui debet: Aliud verò,
jus vocandi aut formaliter vocandi Pa-
stores, non hoc volo, ac si Magistratus
solus exclusâ Ecclesia, posset vocare Pas-
saepissime & forte ad minimum tricies in hac disputatione;

page.notes: Running head reads "De Episcopatu" with "Q. IV." at the right, which is the question marker, not part of the head text. The word "Quæst" in the heading and the abbreviations are as printed. Some words in the lower lines are damaged by print or scan: "Pastores" at the line end is hyphenated as "Pa-stores" and "Pastoribus" continues; "saepissime" is rendered from a partly damaged line and is marked uncertain: "saepi[?]ssime" was considered but the letters read as "fæpissime" in print, transcribed as printed. "nen" in "pastorem nen præfici" appears as printed. The word "vocandi" after "Ut" is clear. Text after "tricies in" is partially illegible in the scan but read as shown.
